headline: OGDCL told the PSX on Wednesday that its Bitrisim Northwest-1 exploratory well in District Khairpur, Sindh, tested 12.8 MMSCFD of gas and 175 barrels of condensate per day, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Well gives 12.8 MMSCFD gas and 175 barrels condensate daily.

caption:
OGDCL finds new gas in Sindh's Khairpur!
According to Business Recorder, OGDCL told the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Wednesday that its Bitrisim Northwest-1 well in District Khairpur has found gas. During testing, the well gave 12.8 million cubic feet of gas and 175 barrels of condensate per day. OGDCL says it will connect the well to the national gas system quickly.
